article.story: DES MOINES, Iowa -- — Jon Carroll scored 26 points as Drake beat South Dakota 81-72 on Friday. Carroll also added 10 rebounds and five steals for the Bulldogs (3-0). Dre Kindell scored 18 points while shooting 5 for 11 (1 for 4 from 3-point range) and 7 of 9 from the free-throw line. Owen Larson shot 5 for 11 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points. Cade Kelderman finished with 18 points and two steals for the Coyotes (1-4). Josh Townley-Thomas added 14 points, nine rebounds and two blocks for South Dakota. Josiah Dotzler also had 13 points and five assists. Drake led South Dakota at the half, 30-29, with Carroll (12 points) its high scorer before the break. Griffen Goodbary’s free throw with 11:19 left in the second half gave Drake the lead for good at 47-46. Up next South Dakota: hosts Doane on Sunday. Drake: hosts Tarleton State on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
